description: Registry of component sources with verified access methods, licensing facts and tracked coverage. Statuses: available = code may be stored locally under a permissive license via an official channel; partial = usable with per-entry caveats; reference-only = metadata + official retrieval only, redistribution not permitted; requires-auth = credentials needed; unavailable = unusable. 'coverage' records what this project has actually enumerated; imported and preview-ready counts are derived from the canonical catalog by the index generator.

sources.name: shadcn/ui
sources.notes: Open registry JSON verified live at https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/[style]/[item].json (registry-item schema). Official CLI: npx shadcn@latest add <registry-url>. Copy-paste is the distribution model, so vendoring selected items locally is permitted with attribution. Tailwind-based; components render in the app only via source-link fallback previews.

coverage.note: Sixteen registry items are tracked. The official library is larger and is not claimed as fully enumerated here; the shadcn CLI remains the retrieval channel for untracked items.

sources.name: Magic UI
sources.notes: 150+ animated components, shadcn-registry compatible (retrieve via the shadcn CLI with Magic UI registry URLs). MIT; vendoring selected items locally is permitted. Tailwind + Motion based.

coverage.note: Four registry items are tracked; the full Magic UI catalogue is not claimed as enumerated.

sources.name: Uiverse
sources.limit: Fair-use policy restricts automated/bulk mirroring - hand-curate individual elements
sources.notes: Community-built elements in HTML/CSS/Tailwind/React. Galaxy repo states all elements are MIT-licensed. Ingested elements are hand-curated with author attribution and are previewable in-app as sandboxed CSS demos.

blocked.label: Bulk catalogue
blocked.reason: Fair-use policy prohibits automated bulk mirroring; individual hand-curation only.

coverage.note: No Uiverse elements are currently imported. Curation remains manual by policy.

sources.name: HyperUI
sources.notes: Free Tailwind CSS v4 components for marketing/ecommerce/app UI. No registry API - retrieve from the official repo or the copy-paste site. Tailwind-based; app previews use source-link fallback.

coverage.note: No HyperUI items are currently imported; the source has no registry and requires manual copying.

sources.name: React Bits
sources.limit: Commons Clause forbids selling, sublicensing, or redistributing the components themselves - alone, bundled, or ported. Application use is permitted.
sources.notes: Animation-first library (~230 components across text-animations/animations/components/backgrounds/micro). Official shadcn-compatible registry verified live at https://reactbits.dev/r/{Name}-{variant}.json with variants TS-CSS, TS-TW, JS-CSS, JS-TW per item. Vendoring policy (M6 correction): the TS-CSS variant is vendored for catalog previews and agent delivery - this is application use, not sale - with attribution and the no-resale clause recorded in every entry. Components whose variant is raw WebGL/Three.js are vendored but never advertised as live in this app's preview; official demo links stay attached.

coverage.note: Sixty-one curated React Bits items are tracked. All remain subject to the MIT + Commons Clause no-resale restriction; source is not redistributed publicly.

sources.name: Aceternity UI
sources.license: Custom free license; source redistribution forbidden (licence page + third-party summaries)
sources.auth: none to browse; Pro tier is paid
sources.limit: No local storage or redistribution of source; third-party components within items may carry other licenses.
sources.notes: 200+ animated Tailwind + Motion components. Catalog keeps reference metadata and official links; the agent must copy from the official source directly.

blocked.label: Source catalogue
blocked.reason: License forbids local storage and redistribution; reference-only entries require individual official URLs.

coverage.note: No Aceternity source is stored. An official URL per component is required before a reference entry can be added.

sources.name: 21st.dev
sources.license: varies per component/creator - verify per entry
sources.limit: Per-creator licensing; their terms forbid redistributing code from libraries that prohibit it.
sources.notes: Community registry of React components. Default to reference-only entries with the official component URL as the retrieval instruction; ingest locally only when the creator's license is verified permissive.

blocked.label: Community catalogue
blocked.reason: Per-creator licenses must be verified before any import.

coverage.note: No 21st.dev item is imported because no contributor license has been verified yet.

sources.name: Originkit
sources.license: custom free tier - verify per component
sources.limit: ~50 free animated components; copy limits on the free tier; full catalogue is a paid upgrade.
sources.notes: Animated React/Framer components with an official MCP server for browsing/import (community-published gateway exists). Reference-first; ingest locally only if the per-component license is verified permissive.

blocked.label: MCP catalogue
blocked.reason: Requires an OriginKit MCP connection/credentials; no credentialed source access is configured in this workspace.

coverage.note: Official MCP is the preferred channel. The source remains reference-only until credentials and per-item license verification are available.

sources.name: Pryzm
sources.license: generator tool - exports belong to the user; gallery looks are remix references
sources.limit: No component code registry; visual gallery is for remixing, not redistribution.
sources.notes: Background/gradient/texture studio with a curated gallery. Use as background and gradient references; the agent recreates looks via the official studio or its exports instead of vendoring gallery assets.

coverage.note: A visual reference source only. No component registry exists; generated exports are user-owned but gallery looks are not redistributed.

sources.name: CodePen
sources.license: varies per pen (author-owned) - verify each pen
sources.limit: Only official embed/export paths; no bulk scraping, private-pen access or unlicensed redistribution.
sources.notes: Saved pens can be referenced or embedded after author/license verification. The requested Multi-Page View Transition example needs its URL and license recorded before import.

blocked.label: Saved Multi-Page View Transition example
blocked.reason: The saved pen URL and author/license metadata were not supplied. Add them via scripts/ingest-codepen.mjs --url=<url> --write after verifying the pen license.

coverage.note: CodePen pens are author-owned. Only the official embed/export path may be used; no bulk scraping or unlicensed copying.

sources.name: Ditther
sources.license: generator exports belong to the user; gallery looks remain reference material
sources.limit: Do not redistribute Ditther gallery effects, presets or prompts. Recreate effects explicitly.
sources.notes: Browser-based image-effect studio (dither, ASCII, halftone, VHS, glitch, chromatic shift). Use as a visual-effect reference, not as a component source.

blocked.label: Effect catalogue
blocked.reason: Ditther is an image-effect generator, not a React component registry; effects are reference-only until explicitly recreated.

coverage.note: User-created exports may be used; Ditther gallery looks and prompts must not be redistributed.

sources.name: GetLayers
sources.license: custom GetLayers terms; source files, prompts and templates may not be redistributed
sources.limit: Never redistribute source files or prompts. Metadata and official retrieval links only.
sources.notes: Templates, sections, 3D scenes, backgrounds and gradients with an official MCP/design workflow. Restricted source and prompt redistribution.

blocked.label: MCP/template library
blocked.reason: GetLayers source files, prompts and templates may not be redistributed; credentialed MCP access is required for retrieval.

coverage.note: Reference-only. Keep official links and retrieval instructions; never vendor GetLayers source files or prompts.
